whatsapp_message.message_en:

Buyers from Delhi/Mumbai are actively searching your category.
A quick geography setting change could get you more leads.
Can we do this together? Takes 2 min. 📱
whatsapp_message.cta: Reply YES for a quick setup call

script_parts.opening: Ramesh Bhai, main aapke account dekh raha tha — kuch interesting chal raha hai. Ek minute hai?
script_parts.diagnostic: Maine dekha leads kum aa rahi hain. Aap Delhi/Mumbai ke buyers tak reach kar sakte ho — kya try kiya?
script_parts.value_demo: Aapke jaise ek seller ne geography expand ki — leads significantly badh gayi.
script_parts.action: Main abhi geography setting change kar deta hoon — 2 minute.
script_parts.close: Renewal ke baare mein pressure nahi hai. Pehle yeh lead pursue karo.

script_parts_en.opening: Ramesh bhai, I was reviewing your account and noticed something interesting. Do you have a minute?
script_parts_en.diagnostic: I see leads have been lower than expected. Have you tried reaching buyers in Delhi or Mumbai?
script_parts_en.value_demo: A seller like you expanded their geography and significantly increased leads.
script_parts_en.action: Let me change the geography setting right now — 2 minutes.
script_parts_en.close: No pressure on renewal. First let's go after these leads.

objection_handlers.competitor_platform: Samajh sakta hoon — doosre platforms bhi kaam karte hain. Lekin IndiaMART pe B2B buyers specifically aate hain jo bulk order dene ka intent rakhte hain. Ek baar compare karte hain — aapke last 3 mahine ke leads ka source kya raha?
objection_handlers.price_too_high: Bilkul valid point hai. Lekin aise socho — agar sirf 2 orders extra aaye subscription se, toh ROI positive ho jaata hai. Main aapke category ke average order value se calculate kar sakta hoon.
objection_handlers.no_time: Koi baat nahi — main ek quick summary WhatsApp pe bhej deta hoon. Aap apne time pe dekh lena, aur jo bhi question ho directly reply karna.

objection_handlers_en.competitor_platform: I understand — other platforms work too. But IndiaMART specifically attracts B2B buyers who intend to place bulk orders. Let's compare — what was the source of your leads over the last 3 months?
objection_handlers_en.price_too_high: Completely valid point. But think of it this way — if just 2 extra orders come through the subscription, the ROI turns positive. I can calculate that using your category's average order value.
objection_handlers_en.no_time: No problem — I'll send you a quick summary on WhatsApp. Check it at your convenience, and just reply directly with any questions.

gifted_lead.fallback: Use peer comparison data as value demonstration

winback_priority.opening_line_hi: Bhai, aap tab gaye the jab leads nahi aa rahi thi. Maine aaj check kiya — aapki category mein abhi 50 active buyers hain.
